confidence_notes: Sparse local price data are a proxy for July meals, cappuccino and draft beer. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Ocho-Rios-Jamaica). comparable_city_reasoning: Negril and Montego Bay provide a basis for lodging estimates because they share Jamaica's coastal tourism demand and have a similar mix of independent guesthouses and mid-range hotels.
